BACKGROUND
Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) performs its regular activities
being funded by revenue budget. However, DGHS finances its development
activities through Health, Population, and Nutrition Sector Program (HPNSP).
Currently, 4th Health sector wide program is going on, which started in 2017.
There are 14 Operational Plans in this program that fall under DGHS. An
overview of the performance of these Operational Plans is provided in this
chapter. In addition, a summary of revenue budget spending is shown in a later
part of this chapter.
